newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells up 2.11 pct on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: John Keells up 2.11 pct on foreign buying.

text.p: Shares of John Keells Holdings Ltd rose 2.11 percent or four rupees to 194 on Monday on foreign buying of 64,000 shares, brokers said.
"With sellers holding back, you have to pay a premium to get quantity," said a local broker who declined to be identified.
John Keells Holdings, which rose to over 400 rupees when the market rallied in early 1994, is considered a bargain at current prices, the broker said.
The firm is one of three diversified blue chip holding companies listed in Colombo.
